description: Public directory of active services, Nigerian areas and approved facilities, plus live Serper web results. No authentication required. Demo facilities are never returned.

endpoints.name: List services
endpoints.description: Returns active services ordered by sort_order and service_code. Service codes are the values accepted by /directory/facilities?service=.

endpoints.name: Search areas
endpoints.summary: Search Nigerian areas by name, city, region or alias.
endpoints.description: Exact matches are returned before prefix matches, de-duplicated by id. Only active NG areas are considered. limit is clamped to 1-10 and defaults to 5. The seeded Ikeja area is a real area (is_demo false); legacy demo areas may still appear with is_demo true.

queryParams.name: q
queryParams.description: Search term, max 120 characters. Omit to list the first areas alphabetically.

queryParams.name: limit
queryParams.description: 1-10; values outside the range are clamped.

notes: Areas are reference data, not facilities. is_demo on an area does not affect facility visibility.

endpoints.name: Find facilities by service
endpoints.summary: Find approved facilities and live web leads offering a service near an area.
endpoints.description: Requires service and area_id. Approved non-demo facilities with an approved service entry are measured from the area centre and filtered by radius_km, sorted by distance then name. When the approved results do not fill limit and include_live is true (the default), Serper Maps is searched for live places; those results are persisted as Source + WebLead rows and appended after directory rows, de-duplicated by name and address, and the merged list is capped at limit. limit is clamped to 1-10 and defaults to 3; radius_km is clamped to 1-200 and defaults to 25.

queryParams.name: service
queryParams.description: Service code such as general, pediatrics or maternity.

queryParams.name: limit
queryParams.description: 1-10; values outside the range are clamped. Applies to the merged result set.

queryParams.name: include_live
queryParams.description: Accept true/false/1/0/yes/no/on/off. Set false to return verified directory rows only and skip Serper entirely.

responses.label: OK
responses.description: Approved directory rows followed by unverified live leads, capped at limit.

responses.label: Bad Request
responses.description: Both required query parameters are missing.

notes: Unknown area ids return an empty array, not 404.
Directory rows always carry source "directory", verification_status "approved" and null live fields; live rows carry source "web", verification_status "unverified" and a source_url.
Live rows are persisted before the response is built, so the id is a web_lead uuid and can be fetched from /directory/facilities/{id}.
When Serper is unconfigured or the live request fails, the endpoint still returns the approved directory rows.
Demo facilities (is_demo true) are excluded from results and return 404 on detail.

endpoints.name: Get a facility
endpoints.summary: Return one approved facility, or a stored web lead.
endpoints.description: Looks for an APPROVED, non-demo facility with the id. If none exists, the id is looked up as a stored web lead (status UNVERIFIED or REVIEW_CANDIDATE). Otherwise returns 404 not_found. Approved facilities include their approved active services and source trust tier; web leads are labelled unverified and include source_url and the source metadata.

pathParams.name: id
pathParams.description: Facility id or persisted web_lead id from /directory/facilities.

responses.label: OK
responses.description: Approved facility detail with approved services.

responses.label: OK
responses.description: Stored web-lead fallback for a live result id.

responses.label: Not Found
responses.description: Unknown id, a non-approved facility, or a demo facility.

notes: latitude and longitude are numbers or null; live-lead detail exposes null coordinates because WebLead stores no coordinates.
Web-lead detail is not a verification: verify a facility by phone before referring a patient.
